scripts.migrate: yarn workspace chaire-lib-backend run migrate && yarn workspace transition-backend run migrate
scripts.migrate-test: PROJECT_CONFIG=${PWD}/tests/config_test.js yarn workspace chaire-lib-backend run migrate-test && PROJECT_CONFIG=${PWD}/tests/config_test.js yarn workspace transition-backend run migrate-test
scripts.compile:dev: yarn workspaces foreach -Apiv -j unlimited run compile:dev
scripts.start:demo: PROJECT_CONFIG=${PWD}/examples/config.js yarn workspace transition-backend run start
scripts.test: FORCE_COLOR=${FORCE_COLOR:-$(test -t 2 && echo 1 || echo 0)} yarn workspaces foreach -Av run test
scripts.test:unit: FORCE_COLOR=${FORCE_COLOR:-$(test -t 2 && echo 1 || echo 0)} yarn workspaces foreach -Av run test:unit
scripts.test:sequential: FORCE_COLOR=${FORCE_COLOR:-$(test -t 2 && echo 1 || echo 0)} yarn workspaces foreach -Av run test:sequential
scripts.test:ui: FORCE_COLOR=${FORCE_COLOR:-$(test -t 2 && echo 1 || echo 0)} yarn workspaces foreach -Av run test:ui
scripts.lint: test -t 1 && FORCE_COLOR=${FORCE_COLOR:-1} CARGO_TERM_COLOR=${CARGO_TERM_COLOR:-always}; yarn workspaces foreach -Av run lint
